Speak to [[Headmaster Kuju]] to begin your [[necromancer]] training.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = necromancer
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out Headmaster Kuju in the monastery.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Deathly Swarm}}
* {{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Truncheon]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Kuju, who is to the right, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ludo
:''"Oh my, a young Necromancer! How very exciting! You should report to '''Headmaster Kuju''' in the '''monastery'''. She will oversee your Necromancer training. Enjoy!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Kuju.
| decline = I'd like to explore a bit, first.
| ask = You really ought to report to '''Headmaster Kuju'''. Do not be afraid, she is very kind. You will find her in the monastery.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Kuju
:''"That Ludo is so sweet, is he not? I love him like one of my own minions."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
